tex_content.html:
Theorem
[The Riccati Equation] 1. ch11:11.4Let $\gamma :[0,b]\to U$ be a unit-speed radial geodesic in a normal neighborhood with radial Hessian operator $\mathcal H_r$. Along $\gamma |_{(0,b]}$, \begin{equation} D_t\mathcal H_r+\mathcal H_r^2+R_{\gamma '}=0, \tag {11.7} \end{equation} where $\mathcal H_r^2(w)=\mathcal H_r(\mathcal H_r(w))$ and $R_{\gamma '}(w)=R(w,\gamma ')\gamma '$.
